facts.value: Applies to Domestic or EU students, or students who have been resident as a taxpayer in EU/EEA/Swiss State for 3 out of the last 5 years.
Tax relief is available on postgraduate tuition fees, up to €7,000 per person per course.
Courses cost upwards of €5,000 a year.

Tax relief is available for tuition fees paid for approved postgraduate courses in private and publicly funded colleges in the State, postgraduate courses in a university or publicly funded college in another EU member state or the UK, including those that provide distance education in the State, and postgraduate courses in a university or publicly funded third-level college in non-EU countries.
